summary: Iteration 6 validation of the architecture/data-flow fixes (Ospitalita page, unified Immobili/Proprieta, Sconosciuto fix, enriched payments/tenants, sidebar reorder). Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass covering auth, enriched tenants, enriched payments (tenant_name/property_address/room_number), payments overview grouping, tenant-existence validation on POST /payments (404 on bad tenant), hospitality PDF generation (valid %PDF header, 200 + application/pdf) and 404 for invalid tenant. Frontend: login succeeds, sidebar order matches exactly the required 12 items (Dashboard, Immobili, Stanze, Inquilini, Pagamenti, Ospitalita, Contratti, Fatture, Proprietari, Notifiche, Report, Gestione Dati). Ospitalita page renders 6 tenant cards with 6 Scarica PDF buttons; clicking the first returned a 200 application/pdf. Pagamenti: no 'Sconosciuto' string anywhere, 'Nuovo Pagamento' dialog opens and the Inquilino dropdown exposes all 6 tenants. Inquilini shows 'Non assegnato' placeholders. Immobili renders expandable property cards with Stanze/Occupate/Libere stats. Dashboard loads without errors.

issues: A11y warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' – add a DialogDescription to the Radix Dialog.
Latin text 'Ospitalita' throughout (no accent). If i18n requires 'Ospitalità', update labels; otherwise safe to ignore.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add <DialogDescription/> inside the Nuovo Pagamento DialogContent to silence the Radix a11y warning.
(Optional cleanup, carried from iter-5) routes/properties.py GET /properties/{id} still computes remaining_balance on embedded tenants – remove to stay consistent with the simplified payment model.
(Optional cleanup, carried from iter-5) Extract the duplicated current-month range / room->tenant payment aggregation used in routes/payments.py and routes/properties.py into a shared utils module.
critical_code_review_comments: hospitality.py correctly falls back to the active contract start/end when check_in/check_out query params are empty – good. Consider capping PDF generation with a timeout to guard against slow reportlab calls under load.
payments.py GET /payments does N+1 lookups (tenant -> property -> room) per payment. Fine at current data volume (<20 payments) but should use an aggregation pipeline once rows grow.
tenants.py _enrich_tenant does a separate query per tenant for payments/room/property. Same N+1 concern on list endpoints.
Frontend Hospitality.js wraps the outer axios call in `try { ... } catch { toast.error(...) }` swallowing the actual error object; log the error to console to aid future debugging.
seed_data_creation: One €1.00 Mario Rossi payment inserted via POST /api/payments happy-path test (notes='TEST_iter6_...'). Can be cleaned if DB hygiene is desired; otherwise harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://property-ops-16.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iteration6.py -v . DB currently has 2 properties, 0 rooms, 6 tenants (all unassigned), multiple TEST_ payments for Mario Rossi. To fully exercise the end-to-end assigned flow (Ospitalita PDF with a real property+room+landlord), create a Room on one property and assign a tenant via PUT /api/tenants/{id} with room_id – then re-download a hospitality PDF and confirm property_address / room_number / landlord_name appear in the PDF. The Sconosciuto bug is resolved (orphan payments now return empty tenant_name, and /api/payments rejects invalid tenant_id with 404).
rca_of_the_issue: All originally reported issues are resolved. (1) Unified Immobili/Proprieta: single property list with expandable cards showing rooms/tenants – verified. (2) Inquilini payment status: Stato Mese column + Deposito surfaced – verified. (3) Pagamenti shows paid vs not_paid via /api/payments/overview grouped by property – verified. (4) 'Sconosciuto' crash: root cause was orphan payments having empty tenant_id; backend now returns empty string (not 'Sconosciuto') and POST /payments 404s on invalid tenant – verified in DB and in UI. (5) Ospitalita in menu and page created at /hospitality – verified. (6) Dynamic connections: tenants carry property_address/room_number/payment_status; payments carry tenant_name/property_address/room_number; properties carry total/occupied/vacant room counts – all verified via pytest.
